Predictor.reasoning: This column lists the names of the variables or traits being modeled (e.g., Body Mass).

Slope.reasoning: Contains the calculated regression coefficients, which are the primary numerical results of the model.

SE.reasoning: Represents the Standard Error (SE) associated with the slope estimates.

z.reasoning: Represents the Z-score used to test the statistical significance of the slope.

P.reasoning: Represents the P-value, indicating the statistical significance of the predictor.
